📋 What this tool actually does

  • AI Media Detection — upload an image, video, or audio file; get a real, explainable analysis combining metadata forensics, Error Level Analysis, frequency-spectrum analysis, and noise-pattern checks.
  • Anomaly Detection — upload any file; get file-structure validation, entropy scanning, hidden/appended-data detection, extension-mismatch checks, and steganalysis.
  • Cross-check online — one-click links to real third-party detectors (Content Credentials, Hive, Illuminarty, FotoForensics, reverse image search, VirusTotal) for a second opinion.
  • Everything above runs locally in this browser tab. No file is uploaded anywhere unless you explicitly click an outbound tool link or opt in to the Sightengine API in Settings.

⚙️ Settings

Optional, advanced, entirely off by default.

Optional: Live Sightengine API

Sightengine (sightengine.com) offers a documented public API with a free tier. If you have your own api_user/api_secret, this app can call their real genai model directly from your browser for a second, model-based opinion alongside the local heuristics. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you fill this in and it is used only for files you explicitly analyze.

⚠️ Kept in memory only — cleared when you reload or close this tab. Calls may be blocked by your browser/network's CORS policy; if so, the local analysis and link-out tools still work fine.
